## Working in `libs/tokens`

- Sources are layered JSON under `src/`: `core/` primitives → `semantic/` roles
  (`color.action.primary`, …) → `brand/<name>.json` overrides → `theme/dark.json`.
- Reference lower layers with `{path.to.token}` (Style Dictionary alias syntax).
- Adding a brand: create `src/brand/<name>.json`, add the name to `BRANDS` in
  `style-dictionary.config.mjs`, and to the `Brand` union + `BRANDS` array in
  **both** `libs/tokens/src/index.ts` and `libs/theme/src/lib/brand.types.ts`
  (plus `BRAND_LABELS`).
- After any change run `npx nx build tokens`; it emits one `tokens.css` with a
  selector block per brand × scheme.
- The generated `generated/` folder is git-ignored and must never be edited by
  hand.
